grid: 1 s step-hold over per-cycle trace samples (20 ticks nominal per row)

terms_grounding.p_H: trace hp samples (server-sent state); rate = trailing 10 s drops, static = 0.5*(1-hp/20)^2, static zeroed in RESPAWN window
terms_grounding.p_F: trace food samples ONLY — saturation is not recorded anywhere; drain = trailing 300 s food decreases
terms_grounding.p_E: derived from hp drop events + deaths; harness-owned deaths (115,116,121,122,123) excluded from the E=1 set
terms_grounding.p_V: state-diff classes over the sample series; weight 0, never enters T

terms_dropped: p_M — no hostiles-with-distance series exists in any recorded store (traces carry hp/food/pos per cycle only)
terms_null: p_N — null on daylight-held days per spec; on unheld/unverified days no world-time series exists to ground seconds-to-hostile-light
